candidate.title: Unbounded table span can amplify tiny DOCX into huge allocations
candidate.originalEvidence: Baseline: src/convert/mod.rs:14211-14216 cell_span parses usize without cap; 13604-13615 sums spans then vec![each; occupancy]/resize. altchunk.rs:563-569 parses colspan usize; 480-486 emits 0..cols. Pending independent validation.

candidate.title: Unbounded numbering level causes billions of resolver iterations
candidate.originalEvidence: Baseline: src/convert/mod.rs:12711-12714 accepts w:ilvl u32; definitions 6619-6621. Numbering::resolve_ilvl scans (0..ilvl).rev().find at 5529-5531; next_marker fills counters 0..resolved at 5610-5629. ilvl=4000000000 yields billions of probes. Markdown clamps ilvl to8.

candidate.title: Chicago numbering start amplifies to giant marker allocation
candidate.originalEvidence: Baseline: src/convert/mod.rs:6750-6753 accepts w:start u32; format_num5861 -> chicago_label6015-6018 repeats symbol (n-1)/4+1. Start2147483647 generates ~1.5GiB; markdown/from_docx/mod.rs:3025-3030 shares list_number helper. Alpha/Roman bounded modulo.
